translation.question: Ni chombo kipi cha udhibiti kilichoripoti kwamba watu kadhaa walikamatwa kwa dosari za uchaguzi wakati wa duru ya pili ya upigaji kura ya uchaguzi mkuu wa Ekuado wa 2025?
translation.translation_note: Translated 'regulatory body' to 'chombo cha udhibiti', 'run-off vote' to 'duru ya pili ya upigaji kura', and 'electoral anomalies' to 'dosari za uchaguzi'.

backtranslation_en.question: Which regulatory body reported that several people were arrested for electoral irregularities during the second round of voting of the 2025 Ecuadorian general election?
